title: Austin Justice: Judges & Land Deals
summary:
*   The committee began with a closed-door session to discuss legal advice, potential land acquisitions, ongoing litigation, and personnel matters.
*   A primary focus was the discussion of candidates for judicial positions in Austin's Municipal Court.
*   The meeting faced an early setback, losing its quorum during discussions about selecting new judges.
*   No final decisions or votes were taken on any of the items discussed during this special session.
